name: JSONB @> via posting-list row-group prune
claim: JSONB `@>` containment with a GIN index AND-merges per-`(key, value)` posting lists at compaction time and probes them at query time to narrow the per-file row-group set.  Replaces the bloom registry for `@>` queries whose terms saturate every row-group (the bench cycles category through 3 values and region through 5 — every term is in every row-group).
